tasks.prompt: Add a function `clamp(n, min, max)` to src/math.js. It returns n limited to the range min..max: min when n < min, max when n > max, otherwise n. Export it the same way the existing functions are exported; use the Grep tool to see how existing functions in src are exported before you write yours. Add tests for it to test/math.test.js: below the range, inside it and above it. Verify: run `node --test` in the repository root and every test passes.

tasks.title: Add slugify to src/strings.js
tasks.prompt: Add a function `slugify(text)` to src/strings.js. It lowercases the text, replaces every run of characters that are not ASCII letters (a-z) or ASCII digits (0-9) with a single "-", and removes any "-" at the start or end. Non-ASCII characters are treated like punctuation, so "Café au lait" becomes "caf-au-lait". Export it the same way the existing functions are exported; use the Grep tool to see how existing functions in src are exported before you write yours. Add tests for it to test/strings.test.js: spaces and punctuation, leading and trailing separators, and an already clean word. Verify: run `node --test` in the repository root and every test passes.

tasks.title: Add chunk to src/list.js
tasks.prompt: Add a function `chunk(items, size)` to src/list.js. It splits an array into arrays of at most `size` items, in order, and throws a RangeError when size is less than 1. Export it the same way the existing functions are exported; use the Glob tool to list the files under src and the Grep tool to see how existing functions are exported before you write yours. Add tests for it to test/list.test.js: an even split, a short last chunk, an empty array and a size below 1. Verify: run `node --test` in the repository root and every test passes.
